summary_en: NAGAILEBEN authorized repurchase of up to 600,000 shares (2.0% of outstanding shares) for up to 1 billion yen through market purchases from October 2 to December 31, 2026, to enable flexible capital allocation in response to changing business environments.
title_en: Notice Regarding Decision of Matters Concerning Share Repurchase
translation_en_brief:
On October 1, 2026, NAGAILEBEN's board of directors authorized a share repurchase program under the provisions of the Companies Act. The company will repurchase up to 600,000 ordinary shares (representing 2.0% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock as of September 30, 2026) for an aggregate amount not to exceed 1 billion yen. The repurchases will be executed through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from October 2 through December 31, 2026.

The company's stated rationale for the program is to enable flexible capital allocation in response to evolving business environments while enhancing shareholder returns. Management emphasized its commitment to prioritizing shareholder returns by comprehensively considering financial condition and share price levels when executing capital policies.
